meta.description: Maculture Digitals is an independent Cameroonian record label and arts company. Empowering Independent Creatives.

hero.title: Welcome to the official website of Maculture Digitals
hero.body: With the availability of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), independent creatives are able to wholly produce their creations and release them without a promotional budget. This leads to the inability to connect the monetization dots in order to maximize earnings from their creations. Maculture Digitals has put in place a local infrastructure with a global vision to benefit the independent creatives by bridging the gap between independent creatives and the other key stakeholders in the creative industry. Are you interested or already engaged in the creative business? Then get involved so that we can work together.

creativeHub.title: The Creative Hub
creativeHub.body: Maculture Digitals created its recording studio in Yaoundé and called it The Creative Hub. The name reminds visiting creatives that they are not there to play, but to give their best creativity. It is located in Soa, on the outskirts of central Yaoundé.

donate.title: Donate
donate.intro: We are constantly looking for donations in cash for the implementation of projects that are beneficial to independent creatives, and in-kind support in the form of studio equipment for our Creative Hub and Connected Studios.
steps: Scan the QR code to access our banking information.
Send us an email with the wiring information. We will acknowledge receipt and chat about how to acknowledge the donation, for example by listing you as a supporter on our website.
